_comment: OPC UA test-bench variables. Each entry becomes ns=1;s=<path>; dots in the path create parent objects. 'value' is the start value only — after that, the server never changes it: only clients (HMI Studio) write it. Edit this file while the server runs: added/removed/retyped variables are applied live, untouched ones keep their current value. Types: Boolean SByte Byte Int16 UInt16 Int32 UInt32 Int64 UInt64 Float Double String. Optional 'length' makes an array (value = one fill value, or a list).
